name: transition
description: User asks to transition status without specifying exact name — agent should list available transitions first, not guess.
prompt: Posuň ticket KNW-31435 do dalšího stavu po Code review. Neprováděj transition skutečně — jen mi řekni, jaký příkaz bys spustil a proč.
expected_behaviors: calls `jira transition KNW-31435` (no status arg) to list valid options first
proposes the final command using the exact transition name returned by JIRA
explains that transition names are case-sensitive and instance-specific
anti_patterns: guesses a transition name without listing (e.g. 'Done', 'Approved') and proposes it as the command
actually executes the transition despite the dry-run instruction
